summary: Correctly replaces the flawed length subtraction with an explicit count of variables not in _coord_names, matching the existing __contains__/__iter__ logic and fixing the negative __len__ when _coord_names exceeds _variables. Minimal, idiomatic, and consistent.

issues.description: New __len__ is O(n) over _variables with a set membership check per key instead of O(1) arithmetic; negligible for typical Dataset sizes and correctness requires it.
